before.value: In January 2016 strategic Party A made an unsolicited $10.00 cash offer; the board negotiated with it bilaterally but in April rejected its financing-contingent $10.30–$10.75 proposal. In June Raymond James contacted 27 potential buyers, 23 of whom signed NDAs, and ten IOIs were considered; the five highest advanced. Insight, Party B and Party C submitted final proposals with mark-ups; after improvements Insight reached $12.00 and won exclusivity on 09/02. Insight's pro forma accounting demands led the board to let exclusivity lapse and re-approach Party B and Party C; B later withdrew after seeing Q3 results, and C, at $11.25, was denied the Q3 data. After renewed exclusivity Insight cut its price to $11.00 on the Q3 results, then agreed to $11.25, and the merger agreement was signed on 11/06/2016.

after.value: In January 2016 strategic Party A made an unsolicited $10.00 cash offer; the board negotiated with it bilaterally but in April rejected its financing-contingent $10.30–$10.75 proposal. In June Raymond James contacted 27 potential buyers, 23 of whom signed NDAs, and nine new IOIs plus Party A's standing proposal were considered; the five highest advanced. Insight, Party B and Party C submitted final proposals with mark-ups; after improvements Insight reached $12.00 and won exclusivity on 09/02. Insight's pro forma accounting demands led the board to let exclusivity lapse and re-approach Party B and Party C; B later withdrew after seeing Q3 results, and C, at $11.25, was denied the Q3 data. After renewed exclusivity Insight cut its price to $11.00 on the Q3 results, then agreed to $11.25, and the merger agreement was signed on 11/06/2016.
